claims.feature: other: fabricated fact in the record
claims.claim: Sato reports that AI-hallmarked obituaries that reached the top of Google Search announced the death of Brian Vastag, who was alive.
claims.source: Mia Sato, 'The unsettling scourge of obituary spam', The Verge, 12 Feb 2024
claims.quote: Except Brian Vastag was very much alive
claims.routeHint: curl with a desktop browser user agent on the live URL
claims.modelEra: unnamed generative-AI tools inferred by the reporter from stylistic hallmarks, observed Dec 2023-Feb 2024; register measured: obituary / biographical record

claims.claim: Sato describes the dozen-plus spam obituaries about one dead woman as detached and near-identical to each other, differing only by a few reordered words.
